title: Team Capacity
description: Delivery and execution metrics by project and creator, including legacy orders.
loadError: Unable to load capacity data. Check material task access and use a date range of one year or less, then retry.
optionsError: Filter options could not be loaded. Please retry.
empty: No delivery records in this date range
incompleteDescription: Quality rates exclude orders without confirmation and submission history. Hours and average time exclude orders with missing timestamps. Only covered records are aggregated; unavailable values appear as —. Exports include coverage counts.
dateRule: New orders use each creator’s latest review submission in Beijing time. Legacy orders use the whole-order delivery date; pending review, accepted and archived orders count as delivered.
deliveryRule: New orders count the latest submitted assets and exclude uploads awaiting resubmission. Legacy delivered orders count assets by their recorded creator without requiring a sub-requirement. Keep the latest version per order, creator and asset name.
hoursRule: For new orders, hours run from the first production start to the latest submission, including waiting and rework. Multiple assignments per creator and order share one interval. Legacy orders without personal execution records do not contribute hours or the average-hours denominator.
qualityRule: Count effective rejection events affecting the creator, accounting for revoked rejections. An order rejected multiple times still counts as one reworked order. Rework rate = reworked orders / submitted orders with complete history.
firstPassRule: First pass rate = orders where all the creator's submitted assignments passed their first review / orders with a known first-review outcome. Any effective first-review rejection means failure. Pending first reviews are excluded.
onTimeRule: On-time rate is on-time creator-orders divided by delivered creator-orders with deadlines. New orders use the latest submission; legacy orders use whole-order delivery. The summary deduplicates orders across creators.
exportError: Export failed or the data changed. Please export again.
